title: Velvety Egyptian Lentil Stew
description: A comforting and floral Egyptian stew featuring red lentils and a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for a sick day. This ovo-vegetarian friendly dish is made with a mixture powder and shio-koji-cure for added depth of flavor.
instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the mixture powder and shio-koji-cure and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red lentils, chopped carrots, vegetable broth, and tomato paste, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Stir in the eggs and cook until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked to desired doneness.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
